dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Hi Niko, this is the intake line at SMD's partner law firm. I understand you'd like to talk about a medical malpractice. Is now still a good time?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, thanks for calling back. So on 2026-04-16 I was walking into the grocery store when medical malpractice happened.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what injuries you've experienced, and whether you've gotten medical treatment?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: I've been having a shoulder injury. I went to Copper Canyon Imaging the next day. They referred me to an orthopedist.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Did you exchange information with the other party? Do you know who their insurance is with?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, Mountain Pass Mutual. The police were also there.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Have you spoken with the insurance company yet?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Not yet, I wanted to talk to a lawyer first.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Got it. One more question — have you worked with another attorney on this matter, or signed anything with another firm?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: I talked to one other firm but didn't sign anything.
